helper.scope: Owned bounded local processes and case-local files only
helper.completion_marker: completed.json is written immediately before sys.exit(7); its exit_code field is the worker's intended code, not an independently collected process status.
helper.signals: The worker records SIGTERM and SIGINT if received. No signal records appeared in these cases.
helper.readiness: An independent command confirmed the process PID alive before each relevant cell return or termination.
helper.input_representation: Script whitespace is normalized; original argument values and operation ordering are retained.
